rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: New Earth Federation forces are closing in on our position... They'll be in combat range shortly.
rows.display_text:
「New Earth Federation forces are closing
in on our position... They'll be in combat
range shortly.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: All units, scramble. We can't afford to lose here with Gibraltar Base so close.
rows.display_text:
「All units, scramble. We can't afford to
lose here with Gibraltar Base so close.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you, everyone. I'll be sure to put everything you've taught me to use.
rows.display_text:
（Thank you, everyone. I'll be sure to
put everything you've taught me to use.）

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: So they mean to keep us from reaching Gibraltar, is that it...!
rows.display_text:
「So they mean to keep us from reaching
Gibraltar, is that it...!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: All units, prepare to intercept. Here they come.
rows.display_text:
「All units, prepare to intercept. Here
they come.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: A force built around the Titans...!
rows.display_text: 「A force built around the Titans...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: There's also a Gundam-type we fought at Fort Severn.
rows.display_text:
「There's also a Gundam-type we fought
at Fort Severn.」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Good work guiding us here, Frost brothers.
rows.display_text:
「Good work guiding us here, Frost
brothers.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: No need for thanks, Captain Yazan.
rows.display_text: 「No need for thanks, Captain Yazan.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: We had a meeting to discuss what comes next with Colonel Scirocco, after all.
rows.display_text:
「We had a meeting to discuss what comes
next with Colonel Scirocco, after all.」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Hmph... gathering intel on half of $c while you were at it, huh.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... gathering intel on half of $c
while you were at it, huh.」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Not missing a trick, are you. If your nose is that good, I bet you've heard the rumors about me too.
rows.display_text:
「Not missing a trick, are you. If your
nose is that good, I bet you've heard the
rumors about me too.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Heh... I'll be watching how the captain they call 'the Beast' fights.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... I'll be watching how the captain
they call 'the Beast' fights.」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Lieutenant! I'm leaving command to you! I'll be doing things my own way!
rows.display_text:
「Lieutenant! I'm leaving command to you!
I'll be doing things my own way!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Yes, sir! Enjoy yourself to the fullest!
rows.display_text: 「Yes, sir! Enjoy yourself to the fullest!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Here I come, $c! I'll get a taste of what you've got!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, $c! I'll get a taste of
what you've got!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Hmph... all bark and no bite, this Yazan Gable.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... all bark and no bite, this Yazan
Gable.」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: But now that the eyesore is gone, this unit is mine in name and fact both.
rows.display_text:
「But now that the eyesore is gone, this
unit is mine in name and fact both.」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: But that unit...
rows.display_text: 「But that unit...」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Data cross-reference complete... So it really was that, huh.
rows.display_text:
「Data cross-reference complete... So it
really was that, huh.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: A transmission...!? From that transformable mobile armor...
rows.display_text:
「A transmission...!? From that
transformable mobile armor...」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Can you hear me, Denzel Hammer. I never thought I'd run into you in a place like this.
rows.display_text:
「Can you hear me, Denzel Hammer. I
never thought I'd run into you in a place
like this.」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: That winged unit is the Virgola that Glory Star was testing, isn't it.
rows.display_text:
「That winged unit is the Virgola that
Glory Star was testing, isn't it.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Do you know the chief!?
rows.display_text: 「Do you know the chief!?」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: A woman...!? You're not Denzel Hammer...!
rows.display_text:
「A woman...!? You're not Denzel
Hammer...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I'm Glory Star's 3rd. $F...
rows.display_text: 「I'm Glory Star's 3rd. $F...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: The chief... Captain Denzel Hammer was killed in action before Break the World...
rows.display_text:
「The chief... Captain Denzel Hammer was
killed in action before Break the World...」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: I see...
rows.display_text: 「I see...」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Hmph... that damn bastard... If he'd been alive, I'd have shot him down with my own hands.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... that damn bastard... If he'd
been alive, I'd have shot him down with
my own hands.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Wha...?

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: You said your name was $f, didn't you. Surrender, and hand that unit over to me.
rows.display_text:
「You said your name was $f, didn't you.
Surrender, and hand that unit over to me.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Just who are you...!? What right do you have to say something like that...
rows.display_text:
「Just who are you...!? What right do you
have to say something like that...」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Shut up, you brat! Glory Star's 3rd should have been mine by rights!
rows.display_text:
「Shut up, you brat! Glory Star's 3rd
should have been mine by rights!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: When the previous 3rd died in the line of duty, the transfer offer came to me.
rows.display_text:
「When the previous 3rd died in the line
of duty, the transfer offer came to me.」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: But Denzel Hammer failed me in the test.
rows.display_text:
「But Denzel Hammer failed me in the
test.」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Saying I lacked some 'quality unique to myself,' if you can believe it!
rows.display_text:
「Saying I lacked some 'quality unique to
myself,' if you can believe it!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: A quality unique to oneself alone... Those are the chief's words...
rows.display_text:
「A quality unique to oneself alone...
Those are the chief's words...」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: If I'd become a test pilot, I could've avoided combat and still had a shot at an elite career...
rows.display_text:
「If I'd become a test pilot, I could've
avoided combat and still had a shot at an
elite career...」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: That bastard... blocking my path to glory, only to bring in some little girl like you instead!
rows.display_text:
「That bastard... blocking my path to
glory, only to bring in some little girl
like you instead!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: If you won't surrender, I'll turn that unit into scrap! Consider it payback for trampling my pride!
rows.display_text:
「If you won't surrender, I'll turn that
unit into scrap! Consider it payback for
trampling my pride!」

rows.speaker: Reccoa
rows.en: This is bad...! $n is shaken!
rows.display_text: 「This is bad...! $n is shaken!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Please fall back, $n! He's targeting you!
rows.display_text:
「Please fall back, $n! He's targeting
you!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: I won't let you get away, woman!
rows.display_text: 「I won't let you get away, woman!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Glory Star, who never recognized me, is nothing but a bunch of freeloading trash!
rows.display_text:
「Glory Star, who never recognized me, is
nothing but a bunch of freeloading trash!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Be silent!!
rows.display_text: 「Be silent!!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: In the chief's place, I'll say it again...!
rows.display_text: 「In the chief's place, I'll say it again...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: You lack the quality unique to yourself alone!
rows.display_text:
「You lack the quality unique to yourself
alone!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: A person like that has no place in Glory Star!
rows.display_text:
「A person like that has no place in
Glory Star!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: You...! Talking to me like that...
rows.display_text: 「You...! Talking to me like that...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I won't allow any rebuttal!
rows.display_text: 「I won't allow any rebuttal!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I told you to be silent! Every word out of your mouth is an insult to Glory Star!
rows.display_text:
「I told you to be silent! Every word out
of your mouth is an insult to Glory Star!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Ngh... nngh...!
rows.display_text: 「Ngh... nngh...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: The chief taught me that there's such a thing as fighting without a gun...
rows.display_text:
「The chief taught me that there's such
a thing as fighting without a gun...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Glory Star was always fighting! Both the chief and Toby, carrying pride and duty as soldiers!
rows.display_text:
「Glory Star was always fighting! Both
the chief and Toby, carrying pride and
duty as soldiers!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Your petty pride could never bear that weight!
rows.display_text:
「Your petty pride could never bear that
weight!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: I've never seen $n like that before...
rows.display_text: 「I've never seen $n like that before...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: I never expected her to show that much open anger...
rows.display_text:
「I never expected her to show that much
open anger...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Just because she keeps it hidden deep down doesn't mean $n's anger and sorrow run shallow...
rows.display_text:
（Just because she keeps it hidden deep
down doesn't mean $n's anger and sorrow
run shallow...）

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: The strength not to drown in sentiment is the will of someone who has something they must do... And what supports that is...
rows.display_text:
（The strength not to drown in sentiment
is the will of one with something to do...
and what supports that is...）

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: A m-mere mascot girl, talking back to me!?
rows.display_text:
「A m-mere mascot girl, talking back to
me!?」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: I'll crush you and prove both Denzel Hammer's foolishness and my own excellence!
rows.display_text:
「I'll crush you and prove both Denzel
Hammer's foolishness and my own
excellence!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: What the chief and Toby left behind, I'll inherit and protect!
rows.display_text:
「What the chief and Toby left behind,
I'll inherit and protect!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Come at me! I'll show you how Glory Star fights!
rows.display_text:
「Come at me! I'll show you how Glory
Star fights!」

rows.speaker: Arthur
rows.en: Confirmed the enemy force has been wiped out.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed the enemy force has been
wiped out.」

rows.speaker: Talia
rows.en: Doesn't look like they're pursuing either. Guess we can breathe easy for now.
rows.display_text:
「Doesn't look like they're pursuing
either. Guess we can breathe easy for
now.」

rows.speaker: Rey
rows.en: We'll be within ZAFT's sphere of influence soon. Once we're there, it'll be practically the same as arriving at Gibraltar.
rows.display_text:
「We'll soon be in ZAFT's sphere of
influence. Once there, it's practically the
same as arriving at Gibraltar.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: A meeting with Chairman Durandal is scheduled at Gibraltar Base...
rows.display_text:
（A meeting with Chairman Durandal is
scheduled at Gibraltar Base...）

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: With the confusion of the multiverse deepening, what does the chairman intend to do...?
rows.display_text:
（With the confusion of the multiverse
deepening, what does the chairman intend
to do...?）

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: $n... The pride of Glory Star really is alive inside you.
rows.display_text:
「$n... The pride of Glory Star really is
alive inside you.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: That was awesome, sis! Way to lay it into that delusional jerk!
rows.display_text:
「That was awesome, sis! Way to lay it
into that delusional jerk!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: R-really...?
rows.display_text: 「R-really...?」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: So it's not just the Ganary Carver data she inherited from Captain Denzel and Toby.
rows.display_text:
「So it's not just the Ganary Carver
data she inherited from Captain Denzel
and Toby.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Those two's souls really are living on in $n and the Virgola.
rows.display_text:
「Those two's souls really are living on
in $n and the Virgola.」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: $n... The way you are now, you're worthy of calling yourself Glory Star.
rows.display_text:
「$n... The way you are now, you're
worthy of calling yourself Glory Star.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Lt. Emma...
rows.display_text: 「Lt. Emma...」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: When we first met at Lutetium Base... even I didn't understand why you were the one chosen.
rows.display_text:
「When we first met at Lutetium Base...
even I didn't understand why you were
the one chosen.」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: But now, I can say it: you have that quality unique to yourself alone that Captain Denzel spoke of.
rows.display_text:
「But now, I can say it: you have that
quality unique to yourself alone that
Captain Denzel spoke of.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you...
rows.display_text: 「Thank you...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Chief, Toby... What's been lost won't come back, and I don't intend to cling to it...
rows.display_text:
（Chief, Toby... What's been lost won't
come back, and I don't intend to cling to
it...）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But I believe I can protect what I have now, and build something new.
rows.display_text:
（But I believe I can protect what I have
now, and build something new.）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: The Glory Star of the chief, Toby, and me is gone, but I have $c.
rows.display_text:
（The Glory Star of the chief, Toby, and
me is gone, but I have $c.）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: And the pride and duty those two taught me still give me strength, even now...
rows.display_text:
（And the pride and duty those two
taught me still give me strength, even
now...）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: So I'll fight... as Glory Star, and as $c...
rows.display_text:
（So I'll fight... as Glory Star, and as
$c...）

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Tch... guess I played around a bit too much. But I've got a bead on some opponents worth enjoying.
rows.display_text:
「Tch... guess I played around a bit too
much. But I've got a bead on some
opponents worth enjoying.」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: With this bunch, I should be able to cut loose properly. Next time, I'm going all out...!
rows.display_text:
「With this bunch, I should be able to
cut loose properly. Next time, I'm going
all out...!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: N-no way...! Am I... going down!?
rows.display_text: 「N-no way...! Am I... going down!?」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: I won't accept it! There's no way I'd lose in a place like thi--
rows.display_text:
「I won't accept it! There's no way I'd
lose in a place like thi--」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: War, and the military, aren't places to satisfy personal desires...
rows.display_text:
「War, and the military, aren't places to
satisfy personal desires...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: A fight with neither duty nor conviction is a force that only spreads sorrow.
rows.display_text:
「A fight with neither duty nor
conviction is a force that only spreads
sorrow.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I deny that. To hold pride in my own fight... to keep living in this world...
rows.display_text:
「I deny that. To hold pride in my own
fight... to keep living in this world...」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: This one's got some skill...!
rows.display_text: 「This one's got some skill...!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Doesn't look like much experience, but good instincts! Seems like this one's the best find of the bunch this time!
rows.display_text:
「Doesn't look like much experience, but
good instincts! Seems like this one's the
best find of the bunch this time!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Tch...! Giving me this much trouble!?
rows.display_text: 「Tch...! Giving me this much trouble!?」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Seems like this is the AEUG commander I've heard rumors about!
rows.display_text:
「Seems like this is the AEUG commander
I've heard rumors about!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: I heard the Federation's White Meteor was with $c, and looks like I hit the jackpot!
rows.display_text:
「I heard the Federation's White Meteor
was with $c, and looks like I hit the
jackpot!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Let's see just how good a hero of the One Year War really is!
rows.display_text:
「Let's see just how good a hero of the
One Year War really is!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Ha ha ha... I can feel how desperate you are, even through your machine!
rows.display_text:
「Ha ha ha... I can feel how desperate
you are, even through your machine!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: This one's fun prey! Looks like the type that gets stronger the more you knock him around!
rows.display_text:
「This one's fun prey! Looks like the
type that gets stronger the more you
knock him around!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: A ZAFT ace pilot, huh! Looks like just a kid, from what I can tell!
rows.display_text:
「A ZAFT ace pilot, huh! Looks like just
a kid, from what I can tell!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Your charge is way too green! Don't think you can take me down with moves that straightforward!
rows.display_text:
「Your charge is way too green! Don't
think you can take me down with moves
that straightforward!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: This one's got good skill too! Coordinators are worth the effort to beat down!
rows.display_text:
「This one's got good skill too!
Coordinators are worth the effort to beat
down!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Both of us in transformable units...! Should make for a pure contest of skill!
rows.display_text:
「Both of us in transformable units...!
Should make for a pure contest of skill!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Careful piloting...! I'd guess there's a woman in the cockpit!
rows.display_text:
「Careful piloting...! I'd guess there's a
woman in the cockpit!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: If you're going to fight me like this, I'll take you seriously even if you're a woman! Feel honored!
rows.display_text:
「If you're going to fight me like this,
I'll take you seriously even if you're a
woman! Feel honored!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Seems Captain Lowen's infiltration is going well.
rows.display_text:
（Seems Captain Lowen's infiltration is
going well.）

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: $c split into two... you'll be working toward our goals.
rows.display_text:
（$c split into two... you'll be working
toward our goals.）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: And we'll have you two bring down the curtain on it yourselves.
rows.display_text:
（And we'll have you two bring down the
curtain on it yourselves.）

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Don't think a girl who's just clever with her hands can beat me!
rows.display_text:
「Don't think a girl who's just clever
with her hands can beat me!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: The Virgola Glory carries the chief's marksmanship data and Toby's melee combat data!
rows.display_text:
「The Virgola Glory carries the chief's
marksmanship data and Toby's melee
combat data!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: And the two of their feelings live on inside me!
rows.display_text:
「And the two of their feelings live on
inside me!」

rows.speaker: Titans
rows.en: Feelings, my ass...! Like that could ever be combat strength!
rows.display_text:
「Feelings, my ass...! Like that could ever
be combat strength!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I'll show you the answer right now! With this GS Combat Action!
rows.display_text:
「I'll show you the answer right now!
With this GS Combat Action!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: ...Simulation complete. Good work, $n, Athrun.
rows.display_text:
「...Simulation complete. Good work, $n,
Athrun.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: That makes five sets done... Let's take a break for now.
rows.display_text:
「That makes five sets done... Let's take
a break for now.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you for training with me, Captain Athrun.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you for training with me, Captain
Athrun.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thanks to you, I think I've gotten a bit of a feel for attitude control in the air.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to you, I think I've gotten a
bit of a feel for attitude control in the
air.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Seems like you're having a tough time since your unit's characteristics shifted away from ground combat.
rows.display_text:
「Seems like you're having a tough time
since your unit's characteristics shifted
away from ground combat.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But thanks to the VWFS, the Virgola can now fight with three-dimensional tactics too.
rows.display_text:
「But thanks to the VWFS, the Virgola
can now fight with three-dimensional
tactics too.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I can also make use of the high-mobility melee tactics Captain Heine taught me.
rows.display_text:
「I can also make use of the
high-mobility melee tactics Captain Heine
taught me.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: My Saviour's movements should be some help too. I'm happy to train with you anytime.
rows.display_text:
「My Saviour's movements should be some
help too. I'm happy to train with you
anytime.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: I'll join in on the training too, $n.
rows.display_text: 「I'll join in on the training too, $n.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Dr. Jie also asked me to report on the Virgola Glory's operational status, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Dr. Jie also asked me to report on the
Virgola Glory's operational status, after
all.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you as well, Captain Lowen.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you as well, Captain Lowen.」

rows.speaker: Vino
rows.en: Man, that Dr. Jie who modified the Virgola really is amazing, isn't he.
rows.display_text:
「Man, that Dr. Jie who modified the
Virgola really is amazing, isn't he.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: My Chaos Leo is his work too. That person's mind is something you could call a treasure of us Chimera.
rows.display_text:
「My Chaos Leo is his work too. That
person's mind is something you could call
a treasure of us Chimera.」

rows.speaker: Yolant
rows.en: ...Sorry. The 'amazing' we meant was more about a different sort of thing...
rows.display_text:
「...Sorry. The 'amazing' we meant was
more about a different sort of thing...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Um... as for the doctor's personality, I'll have to plead no comment on that one.
rows.display_text:
「Um... as for the doctor's personality,
I'll have to plead no comment on that
one.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But I think he's a kind person.
rows.display_text: 「But I think he's a kind person.」

rows.speaker: Vino
rows.en: You don't have to force yourself to say that, $n.
rows.display_text:
「You don't have to force yourself to
say that, $n.」

rows.speaker: Yolant
rows.en: That's right. Rumor has it he used the Virgola's upgrades as leverage to pull some pretty serious harassment, too.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Rumor has it he used the
Virgola's upgrades as leverage to pull
some pretty serious harassment, too.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Eh... well, that's...
rows.display_text: 「Eh... well, that's...」

rows.speaker: Yolant
rows.en: Like he flipped up your skirt, or sniffed behind your ear, or licked the back of your neck...
rows.display_text:
「Like he flipped up your skirt, or
sniffed behind your ear, or licked the
back of your neck...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I-it never actually went further than that, so please don't bring it up so much...
rows.display_text:
「I-it never actually went further than
that, so please don't bring it up so
much...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: But Vino and the others have a point. Bottling up what you want to say just builds up stress.
rows.display_text:
「But Vino and the others have a point.
Bottling up what you want to say just
builds up stress.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: The chief and Toby told me the same thing, about how important mental care is.
rows.display_text:
「The chief and Toby told me the same
thing, about how important mental care is.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: But I'm fine, really. I'm genuinely grateful to the doctor.
rows.display_text:
「But I'm fine, really. I'm genuinely
grateful to the doctor.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: She's a strange person... At first glance, she seems passive and timid, but...
rows.display_text:
（She's a strange person... At first
glance, she seems passive and timid, but...）

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Despite going through such a harsh experience, she hasn't broken down mentally or fallen into despair...
rows.display_text:
（Despite going through such a harsh
experience, she hasn't broken down
mentally or fallen into despair...）

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Nor does she lose herself to anger or hatred. Where on earth does this person's core strength come from...?
rows.display_text:
（Nor does she lose herself to anger or
hatred. Where on earth does this person's
core strength come from...?）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: ...Is there something on my face?
rows.display_text: 「...Is there something on my face?」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: N-no... it's nothing. Sorry about that.
rows.display_text: 「N-no... it's nothing. Sorry about that.」

rows.speaker: Vino
rows.en: That's no good, Captain. If Lunamaria and the others found out you were staring at $n like that, it'd be a huge deal.
rows.display_text:
「That's no good, Captain. If Lunamaria
and the others caught you staring at $n
like that, it'd be a huge deal.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: That's not what this is...!
rows.display_text: 「That's not what this is...!」

rows.speaker: Yolant
rows.en: Being popular sure is rough, huh. ...Wait, I feel like I said that same line during the last battle too.
rows.display_text:
「Being popular sure is rough, huh.
...Wait, I feel like I said that same line
during the last battle too.」

rows.speaker: Vino
rows.en: Koji, Toshiya, Captain Athrun... Man, I'm jealous.
rows.display_text:
「Koji, Toshiya, Captain Athrun... Man, I'm
jealous.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: M-more importantly than that...!
rows.display_text: 「M-more importantly than that...!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Oh... he's getting flustered.
rows.display_text: （Oh... he's getting flustered.）

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: $n, if you want to train against all-terrain, all-domain scenarios, I think Shinn's Impulse would be the ideal opponent.
rows.display_text:
「$n, for training against all-terrain,
all-domain scenarios, I think Shinn's
Impulse is the ideal opponent.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's true, but...
rows.display_text: 「That's true, but...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Is he holed up with that Extended again...?
rows.display_text:
「Is he holed up with that Extended
again...?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: The way Shinn's so wrapped up in that girl of his seems unnatural, doesn't it...
rows.display_text:
「The way Shinn's so wrapped up in that
girl of his seems unnatural, doesn't it...」

rows.speaker: Vino
rows.en: I think it's sympathy. I mean... he's got his own history too, you know.
rows.display_text:
「I think it's sympathy. I mean... he's
got his own history too, you know.」

rows.speaker: Yolant
rows.en: He's gruff and puts up a tough front, but... he's got a kind side to him too.
rows.display_text:
「He's gruff and puts up a tough front,
but... he's got a kind side to him too.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: But she's an enemy soldier.
rows.display_text: 「But she's an enemy soldier.」

rows.speaker: Vino
rows.en: Isn't that a little harsh...?
rows.display_text: 「Isn't that a little harsh...?」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Even I think so myself.
rows.display_text: 「Even I think so myself.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: But that's what war is.
rows.display_text: 「But that's what war is.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: In the midst of it, Captain Heine lost his life, and Kamille lost someone he'd come to care for, right before his eyes...
rows.display_text:
（In the midst of it, Captain Heine lost
his life, and Kamille lost someone he'd
come to care for, right before his eyes...）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: War just keeps spreading sorrow... That's why I...
rows.display_text:
（War just keeps spreading sorrow...
That's why I...）

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Figured you'd be here, $n.
rows.display_text: 「Figured you'd be here, $n.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Koji... and everyone else too...
rows.display_text: 「Koji... and everyone else too...」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: What's going on? All of you, gathered here...
rows.display_text:
「What's going on? All of you, gathered
here...」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Figured even you couldn't keep training with $n nonstop without your body giving out.
rows.display_text:
「Figured even you couldn't keep training
with $n nonstop without your body giving
out.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Time to switch off, Athrun. This time, we'll take a turn as her sparring partners.
rows.display_text:
「Time to switch off, Athrun. This time,
we'll take a turn as her sparring
partners.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Understood, Lieutenant. I'm sure you'll be surprised by how much $n has grown.
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Lieutenant. I'm sure you'll
be surprised by how much $n has grown.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Everyone...
rows.display_text: 「Everyone...」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: It'd be a waste not to use it -- that Virgola's got all-domain general-purpose weapons and all-terrain capability. Take the best from every one of us.
rows.display_text:
「The Virgola's got all-domain weapons
and all-terrain capability -- don't waste
it. Take the best from all of us.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: First up is our own airhead. Face them as an enemy, and the gap from their usual self will surprise you.
rows.display_text:
「First up is our own airhead. Face them
as an enemy, and the gap from their
usual self will surprise you.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Pleased to work with you, $n.
rows.display_text: 「Pleased to work with you, $n.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Go all out, Touga.
rows.display_text: 「Go all out, Touga.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: We're the supply corps! We brought sweets, so let's dig in once training's done!
rows.display_text:
「We're the supply corps! We brought
sweets, so let's dig in once training's
done!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Carrot and stick, huh. Guess I'd better give it my all.
rows.display_text:
「Carrot and stick, huh. Guess I'd better
give it my all.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: I'd rather be on carrot duty than be a training partner too, honestly.
rows.display_text:
「I'd rather be on carrot duty than be a
training partner too, honestly.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Let's train together, Lunamaria. I was planning to do some shooting practice myself, anyway.
rows.display_text:
「Let's train together, Lunamaria. I was
planning to do some shooting practice
myself, anyway.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: Ehehe... looks like my weak spot's been found out.
rows.display_text:
「Ehehe... looks like my weak spot's been
found out.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: All right, let's get started. Touga, $n... get ready.
rows.display_text:
「All right, let's get started. Touga,
$n... get ready.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Roger.
rows.display_text: 「Roger.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: That look on your face... you're getting serious, huh.
rows.display_text:
「That look on your face... you're getting
serious, huh.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Then, here I come...!
rows.display_text: 「Then, here I come...!」

rows.speaker: Maria
rows.en: Do your best, $n!
rows.display_text: 「Do your best, $n!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: I'm up next, so don't you lose, big sis $n!
rows.display_text:
「I'm up next, so don't you lose, big sis
$n!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Thank you, everyone...
rows.display_text: （Thank you, everyone...）
